claims.content: Bidding on Items for Sale
Customer
The system checks the bidder's sign-in status before allowing a bid to be placed (implying the user must be signed in).
The auction participant must agree to be bound by the Terms of Use Agreement before placing a bid.
Customer clicks 'Place Single Bid' or 'Place SmartBid' button.

trigger.raw_text: Customer clicks 'Place Single Bid' or 'Place SmartBid' button.

claims.content: The Customer views the Product Details Page for an auction item.
The Customer chooses between a SmartBid or a Single Bid.
The Customer enters the bid amount (e.g., in the 'Your SmartBid' field).
The Customer clicks the button to place the bid (e.g., 'Place SmartBid').
The System displays a Bid Confirmation Popup DIV asking for verification (e.g., 'You have chosen to bid $75 on this item using a SmartBid, on a credit card ending in 6744. Is this correct?').
The Customer confirms the bid by clicking 'Yes, Place SmartBid'.
Anytime an auction ends in a tie, the winner is the person who placed the winning bid amount FIRST.

In the event of a non-authorized transaction for orders won with a credit card, the system charges the credit card as soon as the auction is over to prevent accumulated orders from being completely cancelled.

Orders won with an alternative payment method (i.e. PayPal or Amazon Payments) are placed in a Hold status until payment is received; if payment is not received within 168 hours, the item order will be cancelled.

When auction participants who have PayPal or Amazon Payments set as their default Method of Payment do not pay within 7 days (168 hours), those orders will be cancelled and the item placed into a 'hold' status.

2nd-Chance emails will not be sent to recipients who have two accounts and are essentially bidding against themselves (matches found on Customer Name, Customer Phone Number, Customer Email Address, Customer Member ID, or Customer Billing and/or Shipping Addresses).
The email will not be sent if the 2nd-place finisher's bid is below the item's unit cost.
The bid is recorded in the system with a timestamp accurate to 1/100th of a second.
The bid is added to the Item Bid History table, displaying the Name, Amount, Date Placed, and SmartBid User status.
If selected, the customer's preference to be notified by email when their bid is exceeded is saved.
